verdict.rationale: Elicit is built around searching academic literature. Its docs describe semantic and keyword search over 138M+ academic papers, clinical-trial search, and advanced filters by journal and citation count. The Research Agent also pulls from publications, public filings and press releases, and a hands-on user confirmed it returned cited links to papers. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of primary-source coverage beyond a single mention, and consistent hands-on corroboration of search relevance (one tester reported missed key papers and irrelevant results).
